# Figures for research papers and reports

AquaTrajectories includes several distinct plotting families. They are not interchangeable: a *physical target XYZ error histogram*, a *synthetic movement demonstration* and a *real aquarium occupancy analysis* must be reported differently.

## Five publication figure families

| Figure | Function | Required outside evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Feeding index + supplied phase labels | [`aqt_plot_feeding_states()`](../reference/aqt_plot_feeding_states.html) | Externally computed indices and annotated phases |
| Physical target errors in XYZ | [`aqt_plot_calibration_comparison()`](../reference/aqt_plot_calibration_comparison.html) | Independently surveyed targets, partition and physical units |
| Tank-replicated occupancy curves | [`aqt_plot_occupancy_timeseries()`](../reference/aqt_plot_occupancy_timeseries.html) | Tank IDs, scenario labels, independently supplied area fraction |
| Event-relative swimming speed | [`aqt_plot_speed_response()`](../reference/aqt_plot_speed_response.html) | Event clocks, speed observations and tank replicates |
| 2D directional rose | [`aqt_plot_heading_rose()`](../reference/aqt_plot_heading_rose.html) | XY directional conventions and optional source-frame rasters |

The [package visualization source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/PUBLICATION_VISUALIZATION_SUITE.md) documents expected fields, assumptions and file-export instructions.

## Export vector PDF or 300-dpi TIFF

Example of a standard R graphics device, using a *documented package plot* on synthetic random-walk tracks:

```r
library(aquaTrajectories)
set.seed(306)
tracks <- aqt_simulate_tracks(n_fish=5, n_frames=200)
grDevices::pdf("aqt_synthetic_paths.pdf", width=9, height=6)
tryCatch({
  aqt_plot_paths(tracks)
}, finally=grDevices::dev.off())
```

For journals that require TIFF:

```r
grDevices::tiff("figure.tiff", width=3600, height=2400,
                 res=300, compression="lzw")
tryCatch({
  aqt_plot_paths(tracks)
}, finally=grDevices::dev.off())
```

When source coordinates are in pixels or arbitrary units, **do not label them centimeters or meters**.

## Four-panel physical 3D storyboard

[`aqt_plot_trajectory_storyboard3d()`](../reference/aqt_plot_trajectory_storyboard3d.html) uses actual supplied physical XYZ tracks with internally consistent axes and time windows. Missing observations break the path; cumulative distance is **observed**, not necessarily total true movement.

```r
# This example requires existing verified/synthetic XYZ physical tracks.
# Do not create fake z from a one-camera 2D pixel path.
pdf("tank_3d_storyboard.pdf", width = 11, height = 8)
tryCatch({
  aqt_plot_trajectory_storyboard3d(
    xyz, recent_s = 2, max_gap_s = .1,
    tank_limits = list(x=c(0,22), y=c(0,8), z=c(0,11))
  )
}, finally = grDevices::dev.off())
```

The numeric limits above reproduce the package's **example bounds** and are not claimed to describe a surveyed aquarium.

## Optional interactive 3D exploration

[`aqt_plot_tank_scene3d()`](../reference/aqt_plot_tank_scene3d.html), [`aqt_plot_school3d()`](../reference/aqt_plot_school3d.html) and [`aqt_plot_voxel3d()`](../reference/aqt_plot_voxel3d.html) use optional `rgl` paths and require appropriate 3D data. The JavaScript explorer has its own local software interface and research protocol; the pkgdown website itself is a static documentation site, not a hosted video-processing backend.

## Publication checklist

Document source recording and licensing; track and fish ID scope; sampling times; coordinate units; scale and calibration status; experimental tanks; missingness rules; plot aggregation and uncertainty method; and which outcome claims **are not** biologically validated.
